content:
AI

Provides intelligent behavior using behavior tree definitions.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "ai": {
    "templateID": "behaviorTreeID",
    "template": {
      "type": "selector",
      "children": []
    },
    "resolution": {
      "nodeName": {
        "type": "sequence",
        "children": []
      }
    }
  }
}

Description

The AI component provides intelligent behavior for entities using behavior tree (BT) definitions. Behavior trees can be loaded from external template files or defined inline. The component also supports a resolution system for modular behavior tree composition, where empty template nodes can be resolved with concrete implementations.

Behavior tree templates are loaded from bt.[ID].json files when using the templateID field.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
templateIDstringBehavior tree template ID. Templates are loaded from bt.[ID].json files.
templateBTNodeFull inline behavior tree structure definition.
resolutionDictionary{string, BTNode}Resolves empty template nodes with concrete implementations for modularity.

Functions

ai.start

Starts the AI model, beginning behavior tree execution.

Events

ai.{nodeID}.onStart

Triggered when a behavior tree node starts execution.

ai.{nodeID}.onEnd

Triggered when a behavior tree node finishes execution.

Example

JSON
{
  "ai": {
    "templateID": "patrol_guard",
    "resolution": {
      "attackBehavior": {
        "type": "sequence",
        "children": [
          { "type": "action", "name": "faceTarget" },
          { "type": "action", "name": "meleeAttack" }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
